info.title: ferret
info.description: ferret: a ripgrep-compatible search command with ranked lexical (BM25), semantic and hybrid search.

options.name: --ignore-case
options.description: case insensitive search.

options.name: --fixed-strings
options.description: treat the pattern as a literal string, not a regex.

options.name: --line-number
options.description: show line numbers.

options.name: --files-with-matches
options.description: print only the paths of files with matches.

options.name: --count
options.description: print the number of matching lines per file.

options.name: --word-regexp
options.description: only match whole words.

options.name: --version
options.description: print the version.

options.name: --index
options.description:
build or update the persisted index without
searching. With --sem, the semantic index; with
--hybrid, both. With --clean, rebuild it from scratch.

options.name: --clean
options.description:
delete the persisted indexes (lexical and semantic).
With --index, rebuild it afterwards (with --hybrid,
both).

options.name: --lex
options.description:
ranked lexical (BM25) search: the first positional is
the query terms, not a regex.

options.name: --sem
options.description:
ranked semantic (embedding) search: the first
positional is the query. Downloads the model on first
use and builds the index as needed.

options.name: --hybrid
options.description:
ranked hybrid search: BM25 and semantic rankings
fused with reciprocal rank fusion. The first
positional is the query. Needs the semantic model and
index; opt-in.

options.name: --model
options.description:
`download` fetches the semantic model into the cache
so --sem can run offline. FERRET_MODEL_DIR points at
an existing model.

options.name: --limit
options.description:
with --lex, --sem or --hybrid, the maximum number of
files to return (default: 100).

options.name: --scores
options.description:
with --lex, --sem or --hybrid, prefix each result
line with its relevance score.

options.name: --jsonl
options.description:
with --lex, --sem or --hybrid, print one JSON object
per result line (file, line, score, text).

options.name: --no-index
options.description:
with --lex, ignore the persisted index and read every
file.

options.name: --timings
options.description:
with --lex, --sem or --hybrid, print the time spent
in each phase to stderr.

options.name: --debug
options.description: print stack traces for unexpected errors.

options.name: --help
options.description: display this list of options.
